notes.title: Update 3 NOW LIVE (Controller Support added)
notes.notes:
_Partially controller support added (Main menu still needs mouse. We are still working on it. Gameplay menu and gameplay are supported now). We've gotta admit that playing this game with a controller is a whole different experience. It just feels great.

_You can now shoot and walk back in the same time (simply hold space bar or A on the controller while using move keys and shoot key)
_Added more useful tips. 
_Reduced CEP (combat effective points) for some weapons so they can be purchased earlier
_removed Connection Status: Disconnected
_Game now pauses after hitting ESC or Start (controller)
_Balanced some gameplays

We will submit trading cards, badges, backgrounds, emoticons this weekend. Hopefully they will be available early next week.

Please continue to help us by providing helpful feedbacks in Bug Reports forum. We have always appreciated  your valuable supports :)

notes.title: Local wifi only
notes.notes:
After some reports from other players, Online network is not working for most the time or not at all. So we are sad to announce that this game is currently for local wifi only. 

We cannot afford to rent servers that can function as Master servers. 
We will add local coop in future updates.
Please continue to report bugs to help improve our games

We appreciate your constructive feedbacks

notes.title: Regarding the Nature of the Game
notes.notes:
Hi guys. Many people have asked how our game would stand apart from others. The answer is complicated. We love the old coop arcade games, Metal Slug and Castle Crashers of the recent year. They have always inspired us to make games similar to them. We are not trying to do anything revolutionary and 100% original here but something different enough in term of story and gameplay. 

Every RPG needs a start and we need to gain more experiences before we can make bigger indies that attract the eyes of every gamer. Burgers gives us that start. We cannot make a big project and starve along the way before we could even release it. 

The main goals of this game are fast, fun, entertaining, affordable and simple. However, we tried to make the Arena interesting and challenging enough for hardcore gamers too

If the community shows a great support to help us grow. We will be adding free future contents to the game. It will also help us in improving our next titles.
